name: Walther WA 2000 Sniper Rifle
description_html:
BUILT LIKE A BRICK, HITS LIKE A TRUCK

Description

Its big, its chunky and most importantly it can kill while blocking like 90% of your right view. The Walther WA 2000 is a very big and powerful sniper rifle made especially for sharpshooter, although apparently you can carry this chunk of metal brick around.

Can be obtained from PMC and BOSS (Birdeye and Shturman)

Can be bought from Peacekeeper and Jaeger (Most of the attachment is available at Peacekeeper LL2 & LL3, you can do a barter from Jaeger at LL1 and he has some stuff in LL2)

Requested by RaiRaiTheRaichu

1. Download the Zip from the Gdrive

2. Open the Zip

3. Copy the content of the Zip your SPT folder

4. Enjoy
